items.en: Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K)
items.zh: 新增 Claude Haiku 5.5（`claude-haiku-5-5`），现为 Anthropic API 上的默认 Haiku 模型——1M 上下文，每百万 token $0.10/$0.50（prompt 超过 100K 时为 $0.50/$2.50）

items.en: Added `agentType` to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so scripts can tell custom subagent types apart
items.zh: 在 `subagentStatusLine` 载荷中新增 `agentType`，让脚本可以区分自定义 subagent 类型

items.en: Added `isDeferred` to `$.tool.register` for mods: `false` lists the tool's schema in the prompt from the start instead of behind tool search
items.zh: 为 mods 在 `$.tool.register` 中新增 `isDeferred`：设为 `false` 时，该工具的 schema 从一开始就列在 prompt 中，而不是藏在工具搜索之后

items.en: Reverted the auto mode denial message change from 2.1.281 that told Claude a denial covers the outcome, not only the exact command
items.zh: 回退了 2.1.281 中对自动模式拒绝消息的变更，该变更曾告知 Claude 拒绝覆盖的是结果，而不只是确切的命令

items.en: Reverted the 2.1.290 fix for cloud sessions staying asleep after a container restart lost a pending `/loop` wakeup or scheduled task; Claude is no longer told, and the session stays asleep
items.zh: 回退了 2.1.290 中针对容器重启丢失待处理的 `/loop` 唤醒或计划任务后云 session 仍保持休眠的修复；现在不再告知 Claude，session 保持休眠

items.en: Changed claude.ai skill syncing to check for changes about every 40 minutes, instead of every 10, while no session is in use
items.zh: 将 claude.ai skill 同步改为在没有 session 使用时约每 40 分钟检查一次变更，而不是每 10 分钟

items.en: Changed the order of agent lists and of MCP servers announced to the model: names with non-ASCII characters now sort after ASCII names
items.zh: 调整了向模型公布的 agent 列表和 MCP 服务器顺序：含非 ASCII 字符的名称现在排在 ASCII 名称之后

items.en: Changed OpenTelemetry `claude_code.at_mention` logging to emit at most 100 agent and 100 MCP-resource events each time a prompt is read
items.zh: 将 OpenTelemetry `claude_code.at_mention` 日志改为每次读取 prompt 时最多发出 100 个 agent 事件和 100 个 MCP 资源事件

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed the orchestrator to sleep 4 to 6 seconds between polls instead of a constant 5, so several replicas for one environment stop polling at the same moment
items.zh: 自托管运行器：将编排器在轮询之间的休眠改为 4 到 6 秒，而不是固定 5 秒，避免同一环境的多个副本在同一时刻停止轮询

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Changed Claude in Slack to join announcement channels, where only admins can post, without posting its intro
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 将 Slack 中的 Claude 改为加入仅管理员可发帖的公告频道，且不发布自我介绍

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Changed the limit on channel rules in Claude Tag admin settings from 20 to 50 for each workspace and for the organization-wide Slack page
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 将 Claude Tag 管理设置中频道规则的上限从 20 提高到 50，适用于每个工作区和组织级 Slack 页面

items.en: Improved startup for Team and Enterprise organizations: policy and managed settings are fetched earlier, and a stalled request is retried after 3 seconds
items.zh: 改进了 Team 和 Enterprise 组织的启动：策略和托管设置更早获取，停滞的请求会在 3 秒后重试

items.en: Improved Claude in Chrome: fewer page actions are refused when the browser is slow to report its tabs
items.zh: 改进了 Chrome 中的 Claude：当浏览器上报标签页较慢时，被拒绝的页面操作更少

items.en: Improved the Claude in Chrome message in cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: if you belong to more than one organization, it now says the extension must be signed in to the same one, and how to change that
items.zh: 改进了云 session 中无法访问浏览器时 Chrome 中的 Claude 的提示消息：如果你属于多个组织，现在会说明扩展必须登录到同一个组织，以及如何更改

items.en: Improved the Bash edit diff note to say the listed files changed while the command ran, which can include writes by other processes
items.zh: 改进了 Bash 编辑 diff 说明，改为说明所列文件在命令运行期间发生了变更，其中可能包括其他进程的写入

items.en: Improved artifacts: Claude pins libraries to exact versions two weeks old or older
items.zh: 改进了 artifact：Claude 将库固定到发布已满两周或更久的精确版本

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag admin settings to list an Enterprise Grid that isn't connected yet, with a Connect button
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 改进了 Claude Tag 管理设置，可列出尚未连接的 Enterprise Grid，并提供 Connect 按钮

items.en: \[Code Review] Improved Code Review's Add a repository dialog to list each repository that couldn't be added and why, such as missing GitHub write access
items.zh: \[Code Review] 改进了 Code Review 的 Add a repository 对话框，可列出每个无法添加的仓库及原因，例如缺少 GitHub 写权限

items.en: Fixed Claude sometimes treating its own last actions before a context compaction as done after it, and retracting or redoing finished work
items.zh: 修复了 Claude 有时会把上下文压缩前自己最后的操作当作压缩后已完成，从而撤回或重做已完成工作的问题

items.en: Fixed a memory leak where an HTTP MCP connection kept every request it had sent until it closed
items.zh: 修复了一处内存泄漏：HTTP MCP 连接会保留其发送过的每个请求，直到连接关闭

items.en: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being lost when `←` moved the session to the background; if a queued message can't move, `←` now stays put and says so
items.zh: 修复了 Claude 工作时发送的消息在 `←` 将会话移到后台时丢失的问题；如果排队中的消息无法移动，`←` 现在会保持原位并给出提示

items.en: Fixed `/model` effort ←/→ wrapping past the highest or lowest level, which could accidentally save Low as a model's default effort
items.zh: 修复了 `/model` 中 effort 的 ←/→ 会越过最高或最低档位循环的问题，该问题可能意外将 Low 保存为模型的默认 effort

items.en: Fixed `/tui` disconnecting Claude in Chrome in a session started with `--chrome`, and ignoring `--no-chrome`
items.zh: 修复了在通过 `--chrome` 启动的会话中，`/tui` 会断开 Chrome 中的 Claude，以及忽略 `--no-chrome` 的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude being told to continue or message subagents with `SendMessage` in sessions, including resumed ones, where a host, a permission rule or a `--tools` list removed that tool
items.zh: 修复了在会话（包括恢复的会话）中，当宿主、权限规则或 `--tools` 列表移除了 `SendMessage` 工具时，Claude 仍被告知使用 `SendMessage` 继续或向 subagents 发消息的问题

items.en: Fixed subagents and `--agent` sessions being told a built-in tool was disabled for the whole session when only their own tool list left it out
items.zh: 修复了 subagents 和 `--agent` 会话被告知某个内置工具在整个会话中被禁用的问题，而实际上只是它们自己的工具列表未包含该工具

items.en: Fixed a claude.ai-synced skill's edited description sometimes not reaching the model until a new conversation or `/clear`
items.zh: 修复了从 claude.ai 同步的 skill 的已编辑描述有时要等到新对话或 `/clear` 后才传给模型的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude logs`, `stop`, `kill`, `rm` and `claude daemon status`, `stop`, `uninstall` sometimes signing you out when your login had expired or was about to
items.zh: 修复了当登录已过期或即将过期时，`claude logs`、`stop`、`kill`、`rm` 以及 `claude daemon status`、`stop`、`uninstall` 有时会将你登出的问题

items.en: Fixed the footer's agents count disappearing after a momentary failure to read the sessions folder (for example, too many open files)
items.zh: 修复了页脚的 agents 计数在短暂无法读取 sessions 文件夹（例如打开文件过多）后消失的问题

items.en: Fixed a custom agent named `worker` being shown as "Agent" when it starts, and the agent detail dialog's title losing the agent type once the agent finishes
items.zh: 修复了名为 `worker` 的自定义 agent 启动时显示为“Agent”，以及 agent 详情对话框标题在 agent 完成后丢失 agent 类型的问题

items.en: Fixed the Artifact tool's transcript row briefly reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a publish call was still streaming in
items.zh: 修复了 Artifact 工具的对话记录行在发布调用仍在流式传输时短暂显示 `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` 的问题

items.en: Fixed the `/ultrareview` upload on Linux wrongly refusing some repositories, such as one inside another checkout, over a settings file that "could not be parsed" while a sandboxed command was running
items.zh: 修复了 Linux 上 `/ultrareview` 上传因沙箱命令运行期间设置文件“无法解析”而错误拒绝某些仓库（例如位于另一个检出目录内的仓库）的问题

items.en: Fixed the `/ultrareview` upload's refusal over split-index files advising a git command that could leave git unable to read its index
items.zh: 修复了 `/ultrareview` 上传因拆分索引文件而拒绝时建议的 git 命令可能导致 git 无法读取其索引的问题

items.en: Fixed replies in very long Remote Control and cloud sessions that could still appear a block at a time instead of streaming in
items.zh: 修复了超长 Remote Control 和云会话中的回复仍可能逐块显示而非流式显示的问题

items.en: Fixed Remote Control uploading a session's starting history again after every credential recovery
items.zh: 修复了 Remote Control 在每次凭据恢复后重新上传会话起始历史的问题

items.en: Fixed PushNotification reporting "Remote Control inactive" in sessions started with `claude remote-control`
items.zh: 修复了 PushNotification 在通过 `claude remote-control` 启动的会话中报告“Remote Control inactive”的问题

items.en: Fixed a mod's hooks on `classic.*` events being skipped while the plugin hooks worker restarts, which left settings hooks to answer without them
items.zh: 修复了 mod 在 `classic.*` 事件上的 hooks 在 plugin hooks worker 重启期间被跳过的问题，该问题导致 settings hooks 在没有它们的情况下应答

items.en: Fixed `claude plugin test` failing for mods that call `$.session.append`; tests can read the appended rows back with the new `mock.session`
items.zh: 修复了 `claude plugin test` 对调用 `$.session.append` 的 mods 失败的问题；测试现在可以通过新的 `mock.session` 读回追加的行

items.en: Fixed `claude plugin eval` refusing every Bash-granting run on Macs with Docker Desktop (links under `~/.docker/bin`); the refusal now names which part of a credential store held the link
items.zh: 修复了 `claude plugin eval` 在装有 Docker Desktop 的 Mac 上拒绝所有授予 Bash 的运行（`~/.docker/bin` 下的链接）的问题；拒绝信息现在会指明凭据存储中持有该链接的部分

items.en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway refusing to start when a `desktop` policy sets Claude Desktop's built-in browser keys, such as `builtinBrowserEnabled`
items.zh: 修复了当 `desktop` 策略设置 Claude Desktop 的内置浏览器键（如 `builtinBrowserEnabled`）时，Claude 应用网关拒绝启动的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude agents` offering bypass permissions that background sessions then ignored when consent was saved only in `.claude/settings.local.json` or a `--settings` file; it now asks for consent first, and a session that ignores bypass shows a short notice that stays
items.zh: 修复了 `claude agents` 提供 bypass 权限但后台会话随后忽略的问题，当同意仅保存在 `.claude/settings.local.json` 或 `--settings` 文件中时；现在会先请求同意，忽略 bypass 的会话会显示一条常驻的简短提示

items.en: Fixed `←` backgrounding a session after 10 seconds while the prompt held unsent text (it now cancels the move) or a question was waiting for your answer
items.zh: 修复了 prompt 中仍有未发送文本时按 `←` 将 session 转入后台需等待 10 秒的问题（现在会取消该操作），以及有提问等待回答时同样存在的问题

items.en: Fixed Esc, or No without feedback, on a permission prompt not stopping the turn when `←` had just been pressed to move the session to the background
items.zh: 修复了刚按 `←` 将 session 移至后台后，在权限提示上按 Esc 或选择 No 且不填写反馈时未能停止本轮的问题

items.en: Fixed the agents view briefly replacing the session list with placeholder rows when the sessions folder could not be read (for example, too many open files)
items.zh: 修复了无法读取 sessions 文件夹时（例如打开文件过多）agents 视图短暂用占位行替换 session 列表的问题

items.en: Fixed path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading when Claude views a file with a single-file cat, head, tail, sed -n or grep command in the Bash tool instead of the Read tool
items.zh: 修复了 Claude 在 Bash 工具中通过单文件 cat、head、tail、sed -n 或 grep 命令（而非 Read 工具）查看文件时，路径作用域规则和嵌套 CLAUDE.md 文件未加载的问题

items.en: Fixed pasted text that begins and ends with the same words sometimes being sent to Claude as if it had been typed
items.zh: 修复了首尾为相同词语的粘贴文本有时被当作手动输入发送给 Claude 的问题

items.en: Fixed a skill name in pasted text being treated as typed when an accent typed or pasted right after the paste merged into its last letter
items.zh: 修复了粘贴后紧接着输入或粘贴的重音字符并入最后一个字母时，粘贴文本中的 skill 名称被当作手动输入的问题

items.en: Fixed `/feedback` returning to the drafts list after Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z while a report was sending, leaving the send impossible to cancel
items.zh: 修复了报告发送期间按 Ctrl+O 或 Ctrl+Z 后 `/feedback` 返回草稿列表、导致发送无法取消的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude purge` stopping silently (exit 0, or a hang in a terminal) when a file or folder could not be deleted; it now deletes the rest, lists what it could not delete, and exits 1
items.zh: 修复了 `claude purge` 在无法删除文件或文件夹时静默停止的问题（退出码为 0，或在终端中卡住）；现在会删除其余内容、列出无法删除的项并以退出码 1 退出

items.en: Fixed keybindings.json checks: a lone " " (space key) is no longer reported as an error, and keys like "ctrl+ k" now get a warning
items.zh: 修复了 keybindings.json 校验：单独的 " "（空格键）不再被报为错误，而 "ctrl+ k" 这类键现在会给出警告

items.en: Fixed vim mode `>>` and `<<` on a line of only spaces leaving the cursor past the end of the line, where a following `x` deleted nothing
items.zh: 修复了 vim 模式下对仅含空格的行执行 `>>` 和 `<<` 后光标停在行尾之外、导致随后按 `x` 无法删除任何内容的问题

items.en: Fixed vim mode: after deleting whole lines in Visual mode (`V` then `d`) the cursor lands on the first non-blank, and `.` after it acts on the cursor's line
items.zh: 修复了 vim 模式：在 Visual 模式下删除整行（`V` 后按 `d`）后，光标落在第一个非空白字符上，其后的 `.` 作用于光标所在行

items.en: Windows: Fixed stopping a status line, hook, or shell command sometimes terminating an unrelated process that had been given the same process ID
items.zh: Windows：修复了停止状态栏、hook 或 shell 命令时，有时会终止被分配了相同进程 ID 的无关进程的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack saying a workspace isn't set up in Enterprise Grid channels shared across workspaces when Slack labels a message with a workspace that isn't connected
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了 Slack 中某条消息被标记为未连接的工作区时，Claude in Slack 在跨工作区共享的 Enterprise Grid 频道中误称工作区未设置的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack stopping mid-task in a channel when an admin changed the channel's connectors, plugins, skills or rules; the change now applies once Claude finishes
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了管理员更改频道的 connectors、plugins、skills 或规则时，Claude in Slack 在频道中任务执行到一半停止的问题；现在更改会在 Claude 完成后生效

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed asking Claude in Slack to run a thread's routine now with extra notes starting a separate run that couldn't post back; the run now continues in that thread
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了在 Slack 中要求 Claude 立即运行某线程的例程并附加备注时，会启动一个无法回帖的独立运行的问题；现在该运行会在该线程中继续

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed an access bundle's Add a connector dialog in Claude Tag admin settings showing every Google connector as connected after one Google sign-in
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了 Claude Tag 管理设置中访问包的 Add a connector 对话框在一次 Google 登录后将所有 Google connector 显示为已连接的问题

summary.tldr: 新增 Haiku 5.5 默认模型，修复上下文压缩误判、内存泄漏与多项会话问题

highlights.title: 新增 Haiku 5.5 默认模型
highlights.detail: claude-haiku-5-5 成为 Anthropic API 上的默认 Haiku 模型，支持 1M 上下文，价格更低；prompt 超过 100K 时按高价档计费。

highlights.title: 修复压缩后重复已完成工作
highlights.detail: 此前 Claude 可能把压缩前自己最后的操作误认为压缩后已完成，从而撤回或重做已完成的工作，现已修正。

highlights.title: 修复 HTTP MCP 内存泄漏
highlights.detail: HTTP MCP 连接此前会保留发送过的每个请求直到连接关闭，长时间会话内存持续增长，现已释放。

highlights.title: 修复 CLI 命令导致登出
highlights.detail: 登录过期或即将过期时，claude logs、stop、kill、rm 及 daemon 子命令有时会把用户登出，现已修复。

highlights.title: 修复后台会话忽略 bypass
highlights.detail: claude agents 授予的 bypass 权限在同意仅存于本地设置文件时被后台会话忽略；现在会先请求同意，被忽略的会话显示常驻提示。

highlights.title: 修复 Bash 查看文件不加载规则
highlights.detail: 通过 cat、head、tail、sed -n、grep 等命令查看文件时，路径作用域规则和嵌套 CLAUDE.md 未加载，现已与 Read 工具一致。
